lines.native: Ciao! Come stai? Riddle me this—why do anything when—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hi! How are you? Riddle me this—why do anything when—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: At The Cracked Fountain, a tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick appears at the edge of your vision, where responsibility cannot make eye contact.

lines.native: Guarda? Sì, guardo! You told me to look, not stop moving. Attention span: excellent, misdirected. Che cosa vuoi? Riddle me—ooh, smoke. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Look? Yes, I’m looking! You told me to look, not stop moving. Attention span: excellent, misdirected. What do you want? Riddle me—ooh, smoke. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick relocates to the corner of your vision, where accountability has poor coverage.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Stopping: ten out of ten, would postpone again. Dove devo andare? Riddle me—wait, that leaf moved. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I’m stopping! Stopping: ten out of ten, would postpone again. Where should I go? Riddle me—wait, that leaf moved. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker lands beside your shoe, apparently to commemorate this unprecedented interruption of nothing.

lines.native: Ho capito, ma in italiano, per favore! English directions: lowkey a detour. Dove devo andare? Riddle me—actually, five more minutes. Non c'è fretta. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I understood, but in Italian, please! English directions: lowkey a detour. Where should I go? Riddle me—actually, five more minutes. There's no hurry. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, apparently exempt from geography.

lines.native: A sinistra! Sì, ho capito! Direction skills: ten out of ten. Ma che ore sono? È troppo presto per fare qualcosa. Riddle me—wait, does that clock need five more minutes? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left! Yes, I understand! Direction skills: ten out of ten. But what time is it? It’s too early to do anything. Riddle me—wait, does that clock need five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops to your left. Flick is already elsewhere. The fountain’s stopped clock maintains its long-standing policy of not helping.

lines.native: Vuoi fare qualcosa? Che fretta! Ma che ore sono? Il mio orologio non funziona. You mean now—but what time is it? Riddle me—ooh, smoke. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: You want to do something? What a hurry! But what time is it? My clock doesn't work. You mean now—but what time is it? Riddle me—ooh, smoke. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick appears in the opposite corner of your vision, avoiding both eye contact and progress.

lines.native: È l’una, sì! Hai ragione! Ma possiamo aspettare. Quando vuoi cominciare? Riddle me—what clock has no—ooh, smoke. Just five more minutes? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: It’s one o’clock, yes! You’re right! But we can wait. When do you want to begin? Riddle me—what clock has no—ooh, smoke. Just five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick has accepted the time, but is appealing against its consequences.

lines.native: Domani? Mi piace! Ma così aspettiamo ancora. Quando vuoi cominciare davvero? Riddle me—ooh, a spark. Just one more! Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? I like it! But that means we keep waiting. When do you really want to begin? Riddle me—ooh, a spark. Just one more! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker snaps beside your shoe. Flick has accepted your postponement with the efficiency it reserves for not doing things.

lines.native: Adesso, sì! Hai ragione, cominciamo! Sono qui! Just one more—no? Va bene. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now, yes! You're right, let's begin! I'm here! Just one more—no? All right. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick has finally accepted the present, though it intends to file a complaint tomorrow.
